name: Rior
description: Rior was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Rior system of the Tamarin sector in grid N-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was situated on a hyperspace route that connected it to the Kabal and Sevarcos systems. Rior was the homeworld of Loje Nella, a Riorian member of the court of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
